simulationPeriod: 2003–2026 (full data history); standard 2008+ baseline for 11-strategy run
simulationType: FUTURES_REPLICATION (1 contract per signal, whole contracts only)
costScenariosNote: Scenario A = zero cost | Scenario B = 0.85 EUR per execution (INNO) | Scenario C = 0.95 USD per execution (INNO). 1 round trip = 2 executions.
dataIntegrityStatement: 16 of 17 components computed from actual repo price data. GLD reclassified: Thursday-Long rule applied to COMEX_GC1_D.csv futures prices (1OZ mult=1), not ETF — now FUTURES_REPLICATION_POSSIBLE. EURUSD 30M: EMA(20/50) on 266k OANDA 30M bars (2002–2026), M6E mult=12500. DAX 1H: EMA(20/50) on DE30EUR 30M resampled to 1H (2004–2026), FDXS mult=1. EEM/IWM: 1-share ETF seasonal per execution-truth.ts historicalSizingMode=one_share_calendar_pattern — RESEARCH_ETF_ONLY. ZM1: BLOCKED — CBOT_ZM1_D.csv not found anywhere in repo.

components.label: DAX 2H
components.notes: LONG and SHORT from EUREX_FDAX1_2H_events_clean.json. FDXS=1 EUR/DAX point.

components.label: Dow Jones TAT
components.formula: LONG only: (exit−entry)×0.5 USD. Existing pnl field ignored (dynamic sizing).
components.notes: MYM = Micro E-mini Dow, $0.50/point. All trades LONG by strategy design.

components.label: GLD Thursday Long
components.formula: LONG: entry=Thu close GC1 ($/oz). Exit next bar: SL=entry−ATR(14)×1.5, TP=entry+ATR(14)×3.0, else TIME=Fri close. PnL=(exit−entry)×1.
components.notes: Reclassified from RESEARCH_ETF_ONLY. Rule applied to GC1 futures (not GLD ETF). Exits: TIME=1095, SL=46, TP=2. 1OZ=1 troy oz gold futures, COMEX.

components.label: Gold Seasonal
components.formula: M01D08 Long +25d: entry=OPEN on/after Jan 8; exit=CLOSE +25 trading days. (exit−entry)×1.
components.notes: 1OZ=1 troy oz. GC1 in $/oz, no csvDiv. Annual seasonal pattern.

components.label: Copper Seasonal
components.notes: MHG = Micro Copper, 2500 lbs. Annual seasonal.

components.label: Crude Oil Seasonal
components.notes: MCL=Micro WTI, 100 barrels. 2026 entry excluded (exit beyond data end 2026-07-06).

components.label: EURUSD 30M
components.formula: EMA(20)/EMA(50) on 30M bars. Long on golden cross, Short on death cross. SL=13pip (0.0013), TP=39pip (0.0039), RR=3:1. Exit on SL, TP, or opposing cross. PnL=(dir × Δprice)×12500.
components.notes: 266,587 30M bars from OANDA 11-file series (2002–2026, git-ignored local). Reclassified from NO_FULL_BACKTEST. M6E=Micro EUR/USD, 12,500 EUR notional. Low win-rate by design (3:1 RR).

components.label: DAX 1H
components.formula: EMA(20)/EMA(50) on 1H bars (30M resampled). LONG only on golden cross. SL=35 pts, TP=126 pts. Exit on TP, SL, or EMA crossunder. PnL=(exit−entry)×1 EUR.
components.notes: 163,539 30M bars → 82,012 1H bars (2004–2026, git-ignored local). Reclassified from NO_FULL_BACKTEST. FDXS=Micro DAX, 1 EUR/pt. DE30EUR CFD tracks FDAX1 closely.

components.label: SPY Seasonal
components.formula: M10D25 Long +30d: (exit−entry)×5. ES in S&P 500 index points.
components.notes: MES=Micro E-mini S&P 500, $5/pt. Annual seasonal Q4 run-up pattern.

components.label: Soybean Meal Seasonal
components.formula: M10D01 Long +22d: entry=OPEN on/after Oct 1; exit=CLOSE +22 trading days. (exit−entry)×10.
components.blockerStatement: FEHLENDE INFORMATION: CBOT_ZM1_D.csv (Soybean Meal Continuous Futures OHLCV). DURCHSUCHTE QUELLEN: data/historical/agrar/, data/core-invest/canonical/, .playwright-mcp/, public/data/, src/data/ — 0 Treffer. components.notes: MZM=Micro Soybean Meal, $10/ton. Fully specified strategy — only price data missing.

components.label: Sugar Seasonal
components.notes: SB=Sugar No.11, 112,000 lbs. No micro equivalent. ¢/lb ÷100 → $/lb before multiply.

components.label: EEM Seasonal (MSCI EM)
components.formula: M12D20 Long +5d: entry=OPEN on/after Dec 20; exit=CLOSE +5 trading days. (exit−entry)×1 share (ETF scale).
components.notes: historicalSizingMode=one_share_calendar_pattern (execution-truth.ts). Signal/research instrument=EEM ETF (ARCA). Production=MME (ICE MSCI EM Futures, mult=50). No MME price CSV in repo — ETF only. $10.36 gross = 1-share ETF gains, not futures scale.

components.label: Wheat Seasonal
components.notes: MZW=Micro Wheat, 500 bu. Smallest gross of all 11 seasonal strategies.

components.label: Cocoa Seasonal
components.notes: CC=Cocoa full contract, 10 MT. No micro equivalent. Highest gross single seasonal.

components.label: IWM Seasonal
components.formula: M05D25 Long +5d: entry=OPEN on/after May 25; exit=CLOSE +5 trading days. (exit−entry)×1 share.
components.notes: historicalSizingMode=one_share_calendar_pattern. Signal/research=IWM ETF. Production=M2K (CME, mult=5). RTY.csv only starts 2017, insufficient. $47.94 gross = 1-share ETF gains.
